ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels and 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels distributed across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive mottling pattern. High-intensity light pixels dominate the central and medial regions of both lobes, while low-intensity dark pixels form thick contiguous bands along the leading and trailing edges, interspersed with dark vertical linear streaks across the central lobe planes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible portion of the central depression indicates a narrow V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 35-45 degrees; however, the precise vertex and depth are null due to occlusion by turbulent water pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge of both lobes; pixel-amplitude of variations varies from 5 to 25 pixels, creating a jagged, non-linear boundary isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit a strong convex curvature tapering into sharp, upward-pointing acute tips at the distal ends of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white on dark and dark on white) concentrated heavily on the distal tips and scattered globally across both fluke lobes, consistent with localized attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are detected, notably a prominent longitudinal streak on the left lobe and several diagonal scratches on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant three-dimensional calcified protrusions (active barnacle colonization) are visible along the leading edges and distal tips; trailing edges show numerous irregular notches and evidence of tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, thick dark vertical pigmentation line bisects the left lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the lateral tip to the notch.
